credits.overview: Obsessed with food and her body, Mirea channels her anxiety into running until she faints. She is rescued by Lila and her unconventional family, who invite her to a birthday party. A surreal night opens her eyes to life’s choices and her own future, pushing her to make a decision.

credits.overview: Actor Sandro Lanza is experiencing the most painful moment of his existence.
